WHEREAS,DEP has reviewed the ConditionedNegativeDeclaration andfurther reviewed the Phase I and II ESA's and the results of such reviewindicate the presence of hazardous materials; and WHEREAS, Declarant has identified the existence of potential hazardous materials impacts and redevelopment of the Subject Property, and has agreed to implement an approved Remedial Action Plan ("Mitigation Plan"), and submit a P.E. certified Closure Report certifying the implementation of the Mitigation Plan, which shall be submitted for approval by DEP; and WHEREAS, the Declarant agrees to restrict the manner in which the Subject Property may be developed or redeveloped in the future by requiring that additional testing or remediation measures to prevent future exposure to either construction workers orfuture occupants of the Subject Property be conducted and a Sampling Protocol and Mitigation Plan, if any, performed to the satisfaction of DEP, serve as a condition precedent to any change of use or sub-surface excavation conducted as part of any future development or redevelopment of the subject property that breaches either the impacted subsurface soils and/or vapor barrier; and WHEREAS, Declarant intends this Declaration to be binding upon all successors and assigns with respect to theSubjectPremises; and WHEREAS, Declarant intends this Declaration to benefit the owners and occupants of the Subject Premises and the City of New York ("City").
